artifact_observations.location: Throughout the menu text, particularly in the smaller description lines and some headers.
artifact_observations.reasoning: While the main headers ('ANTIPASTI', 'PRIMI PIATTI') are legible, many of the smaller item descriptions and some prices appear as nonsensical character strings or pseudo-text. This is a common AI artifact where the model mimics the shape of text without generating valid characters. Some letters merge or have irregular spacing.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom left corner and edges of the menu.
artifact_observations.reasoning: The perspective lines of the menu columns do not converge perfectly consistently. The bottom left corner seems to warp slightly unnaturally, and the alignment of the text blocks shifts subtly in a way that doesn't fully match a rigid planar surface viewed at an angle.

The paper texture is somewhat uniform but lacks the fine-grained noise or fiber detail expected in a close-up macro shot of paper. It has a slightly 'smoothed' or painted look in the empty spaces between text.
